verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a broad public REST API surface: ingestion, query, raw export, Engage, identity, service accounts, lexicon, annotations, GDPR, feature flags, experiments, data pipelines and warehouse connectors. Each has a downloadable OpenAPI spec, a live per-endpoint 'Try it' playground, service-account auth and dated deprecation notices, so an agent can programmatically ingest, query and manage the product. The probe's 404s on root OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, since the specs are published under docs.mixpanel.com/openapi/. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API, and any documented REST endpoint for creating or managing reports and dashboards (that is shown only via MCP).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Every Mixpanel API is described by an OpenAPI specification. Use these to generate client code, validate requests
The Query API allows you to obtain the same calculated and formatted results that you see from a report in our web app.
Use the Feature Flags API to assign your users to variants for experiments, rollout, and releases.
To export raw event data, use the Raw Event Export API. The events payload is returned as JSONL
